node.title: Prize N=256 profile-(3,6) cofactor-1028 exclusion
node.closure: dual exact finite enumeration plus split-prime test
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(3,6,S=18) cofactor 1028 is impossible. Its multiplicity mu=2 and sharp residual E in {2,3,4,5,6} contain exactly 16 normalized vectors, all at E=5; none has norm divisible by 257.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: dual XOR engines agree on 2409344 targets, 89224 candidate heavy supports, 713792 exact sign tests, and 16 energy-five vectors. All 16 fail the 128-root test modulo 257. Nine profile-(3,6) cofactors remain.
